summary: Today is the day and it's out east — Ditch Plains and Matunuck both have clean 2.5ft SE swell on good-to-prime angles with offshore-to-light morning winds, well worth the drive since Rockaway and Lido are just small cross-on leftovers. Manasquan is the smart middle-ground pick with a cross-off morning if you don't want the long haul. Midweek goes small but clean (Manasquan Wed-Thu shine on offshore mornings), then Friday rebuilds to 3ft at Ditch and Matunuck though wind's a question — weekend cleans up offshore but the swell's fading.
